name: Projected Color-Guided Dynamic NeRF
definition: A dynamic NeRF training method that uses projected color statistics (mean and variance) of sampled points to guide optimization via implicit point correspondence, replacing temporal deformation models.
summary: Projected Color-Guided Dynamic NeRF is an on-the-fly training method for dynamic scenes that replaces temporal deformation fields with a NeRF model conditioned on multi-view projected colors to implicitly track correspondence and minimize optimization iterations.
